WITH album_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AlbumId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price,
    AVG(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL(10,2)) / Milliseconds ELSE NULL END) AS avg_rate
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
global_avg_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL(10,2)) / Milliseconds) AS overall_rate
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
),
final_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    a.AlbumId,
    a.avg_price,
    a.avg_rate,
    a.avg_rate - g.overall_rate AS difference
  FROM album_stats a
  CROSS JOIN global_avg_rate g
)
SELECT 
  AlbumId,
  avg_price,
  avg_rate,
  difference
FROM final_stats
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: All Track records have Milliseconds > 0, avoiding division by zero errors in the rate calculation
